treatment.evidence_quote: Patients received oral MTX at standard of care doses. Mice treated with MTX 1 mg/kg or 50 mg/kg daily or folic acid 50 mg/kg.
treatment.section: STAR METHODS — Gnotobiotic mouse studies; NYU Human RA patient samples acquisition
treatment.notes: All RA patient participants received oral MTX; gnotobiotic mice received low-dose (1 mg/kg) or high-dose (50 mg/kg) MTX or vehicle controls.

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: Not applicable; study is of RA patients and healthy donors, not cancer patients.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: MTX-R exhibited a significant decrease in Bacteroidetes. RA patient microbiotas were sensitive to MTX and changes in gut bacterial taxa and gene family abundance were distinct between responders and non-responders.
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified across different experimental contexts (mouse, patient, cellular).

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: All reported values are reported as percentage of cells or fold change percentage in which values are normalized to the pre-MTX group.
biomarker_unit.section: Methods — Analysis of immune cell markers from transplanted gnotobiotic mice
biomarker_unit.notes: Units vary depending on biomarker type.

value: 18 significant positive correlations and 1 negative correlation
96 gene families passed multiple testing correction
biomarker_value.evidence_quote: 7 immunocyte populations (including B220+, CD44+ CD69+ CD4+, and Gr1+ CD11b+ cells), were significantly lower and 1 was significantly higher in the post-MTX recipients (range: 0.64–1.33).
biomarker_value.section: Results — The post-treatment microbiome decreases host immune activation
biomarker_value.notes: Values are reported as fold changes, correlation counts, and differentially abundant features.

disease_response_os.notes: This study is about rheumatoid arthritis treatment response and microbiome changes, not cancer survival or overall mortality outcomes.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; overall survival not measured in this study.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status was not assessed or reported in this study.

feces_phenotype_value.section: Results — Methotrexate has a broad impact on the human gut microbiota in gnotobiotic mice; Clinical relevance
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal phenotypes describe changes in bacterial community composition and structure.
